properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Supportability, logistics and operational maintenance capability
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Integrated logistics support, operational availability and current IEC supportability practice.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Provision spares, tools, manuals, trained maintainers and maintenance facilities to meet downtime targets.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A maintainable design remains unavailable because diagnosis, administration, transport, spares, credentials, tools, documentation or personnel are delayed.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: The complete support system restores required function within the operational downtime bound across deployed locations and mission conditions.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Low bench repair time is overwhelmed by waiting, access, approval, supplier lead time, obsolete parts, unavailable expertise or incompatible configuration.
properties.MECHANISM: Model and measure total downtime; provision/position resources; exercise escalation; manage obsolescence; sustain documentation, credentials and skills.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Distributed fleets, remote/contested sites, long-life assets, supplier concentration, strict availability or disaster recovery.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low-criticality items, accept longer restoration or stock simple replacements rather than build a complex support network.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Demand rates, repair-level policy, supply data, workforce readiness, transport/access, contracts, configuration and obsolescence monitoring.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Aligns achieved/operational availability with real support conditions rather than inherent design promises.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Fleet/asset owner, logistics organisation, operator, maintainer and mission planner.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Paper spares; wrong revision; expired credentials; inaccessible facility; unsupported dependency; concentrated specialist; supply disruption.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Stocking and spare capacity are costly; forecasts are uncertain; overprovisioning can create obsolescence and maintenance burden.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Spares provisioning broadened to lifecycle supportability, digital/software dependencies, remote operations and obsolescence management.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A tested support concept with total-downtime data, resource/configuration identity, alternatives and explicit risk acceptance for uncovered sites/times.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A logistics plan or SLA is not the property; actual timely access to the right resources is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Meta’s secure physical access delayed repair; GitLab relied on slower infrastructure in another region; both show logistics/access are reliability mechanisms (SRC-059, SRC-060).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: High reliability or local repairability can reduce support demand, but does not eliminate the need to validate residual support assumptions.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should supply-chain and workforce correlation be integrated with traditional stochastic availability models?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Maintenance-induced failure and maintenance human factors as system mechanisms
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Field maintenance experience, RCM, human-factors programmes and common-cause analysis.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Record maintenance error as a cause category and improve procedures/training.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Inspection, calibration, replacement, access, configuration or repair can introduce faults, disable redundancy or create shared misconfiguration.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Maintenance must preserve or restore the required function without creating a new latent, common-cause or interface failure.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Wrong part/configuration, omitted step, damage during access, common calibration error, simultaneous channel disablement or ineffective verification.
properties.MECHANISM: Design out error opportunities; control configuration; isolate channels; use usable procedures/tools; manage fatigue/communication; verify function after work; learn without individual blame substitution.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Intrusive maintenance, repeated “no fault found,” common-channel work, difficult access, night/remote work, complex software/configuration changes.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Eliminate unnecessary maintenance or replace a fragile manual step with a simple poka-yoke/functional check where that is safer.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Work-as-done observation, maintainability design, staffing/fatigue controls, independent verification, event reporting and organisational learning.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces recurrence, common-cause exposure and downtime produced by the maintenance system itself.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Maintainer, operator, fleet/service owner and mission authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Blame-only investigation; unreadable procedures; undocumented workaround; verifier shares same misconception; work performed on both redundant channels.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: “Human error” can become a residual label that hides design and organisational causes; added checks can create workload and new failure modes.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Person-centred error counting evolved toward design-for-maintenance, organisational conditions, independent verification and work-as-done evidence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Maintenance treated as an operational mode with its own hazards, dependencies, state transitions, common-cause controls and post-maintenance functional proof.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A sign-off or training record is not the property; reduced error opportunity and verified post-work function are.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: AWS’s event began with an authorised maintenance command whose input removed excess capacity; GitLab’s recovery work accidentally removed the primary data directory (SRC-058, SRC-060).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Some maintenance errors are genuinely individual slips, but durable control still requires analysing the conditions and barriers around them.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which post-maintenance checks best detect semantic/configuration errors without duplicating the entire mission test?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Age-based preventive maintenance only for valid age-related mechanisms
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Replacement theory and scheduled overhaul; narrowed by airline RCM evidence and modern life-data modelling.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Replace or overhaul at a fixed age to avoid wear-out.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Scheduled intervention cannot reduce random/weakly age-related failures and may introduce maintenance faults or waste useful life.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Reduce mission failure or lifecycle consequence by acting before a demonstrable age-related risk rise.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A convenient age limit is imposed without a dominant wear-out mode, stable age relationship or evidence that overhaul restores resistance.
properties.MECHANISM: Identify failure mechanism and conditional age-risk; estimate survival/uncertainty; compare maintenance-induced risk and cost; verify post-task reliability.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Dominant wear-out, fatigue, corrosion, consumable depletion or legally/physically bounded life with observable age/exposure.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Run to failure, inspect condition or use simple replacement-on-failure when consequence and restoration support permit.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Mechanism-specific life data, exposure rather than calendar age where appropriate, restoration-effect evidence and maintenance quality.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents predictable wear-out while avoiding ritual overhaul of items without useful age limits.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Maintenance planner, asset/fleet owner and mission-risk authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Calendar age used instead of cycles/stress; mixture populations; changed materials; overhaul not as-good-as-new; invasive task causes failure.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The famous RCM pattern proportions are aircraft-specific; they justify mechanism testing, not a universal claim that age never matters.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Universal scheduled overhaul narrowed to mechanism- and consequence-specific age tasks with field-data refresh.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A maintenance interval justified by a causal degradation mechanism, exposure model, uncertainty, task effectiveness and net-consequence comparison.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A preventive-maintenance calendar is not the property; intervention before a validated age-linked risk is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Nowlan and Heap found multiple age-reliability patterns and set applicability conditions for scheduled rework rather than endorsing universal intervals (SRC-008).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Strong wear-out mechanisms and finite-life items provide robust contexts where age-based replacement is retained.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should sparse field data be pooled across configurations without erasing mechanism differences?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Condition-based and predictive maintenance only with observable precursors and decision value
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: On-condition RCM, machinery condition monitoring, PHM and modern ML/digital-twin predictive maintenance.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Inspect a condition indicator before the P–F interval expires or predict remaining useful life to schedule work.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Fixed schedules waste life, but predictions can be uncalibrated, late, false-positive or non-transferable and can trigger harmful maintenance.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Detect actionable degradation with enough lead time and confidence that intervention reduces expected mission/lifecycle loss.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: No stable precursor; sensor drift; domain shift; uncertain RUL ignored; maintenance action ineffective; false alarms dominate; lead time shorter than logistics delay.
properties.MECHANISM: Validate precursor-to-failure relation, sensor chain, uncertainty, lead-time distribution and intervention effect; optimise against simple policies; monitor drift.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Failure mechanisms with measurable deterioration, sufficient lead time, meaningful consequence and an effective intervention.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use inspection, fixed replacement or run-to-failure when a simple policy performs similarly or data/precursors are inadequate.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Reliable sensing, labelled/field failure data, calibrated uncertainty, domain representativeness, maintenance capacity and action-cost model.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Targets intervention where it can avert failure while reducing needless planned maintenance.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Maintenance planner, asset owner, operator and logistics manager.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Benchmark overfit; synthetic-data gap; leakage; censored labels; black-box confidence; alert fatigue; action changes the data-generating process.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: The literature is heterogeneous and often laboratory/dataset-centric; no evidence supports universal superiority over simpler policies.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Threshold condition monitoring expanded to probabilistic PHM, hybrid physics/data models, uncertainty and decision-aware maintenance.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A field-calibrated, uncertainty-aware precursor and intervention case compared against a cheap baseline under the actual loss function.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A “predictive maintenance” platform or RUL number is not the property; demonstrated earlier/better decisions are.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Systematic reviews show rapid growth but heterogeneous applications; the 2026 PHM review treats uncertainty as unavoidable throughout deployment (SRC-071–SRC-073).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Well-instrumented monotonic degradation with proven intervention can yield strong value; the result remains mechanism-specific.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How often do published gains survive cross-site transfer and prospective comparison with simple maintenance rules?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Closed-loop test–analyse–fix and FRACAS
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Post-war failure reporting, Duane growth, military FRACAS and formal growth-management handbooks.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Record each failure, analyse cause, implement corrective action and track MTBF growth.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Testing and field incidents generate no reliability improvement when failures are merely logged, classified or closed administratively.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Remove or bound recurrent failure mechanisms in the current design/support configuration and verify the changed mission outcome.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Selective reporting; “no trouble found”; delayed fixes; fix not configuration-bound; no retest; curve fit substitutes for causal closure.
properties.MECHANISM: Unique failure identity; exposure/context capture; causal analysis; prioritised design/process correction; independent retest; recurrence monitoring; fleet/configuration propagation.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Development test failures, repeated field events, unexplained downtime, reliability-growth commitments or high-cost maintenance families.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For isolated low-consequence failures, make the obvious reversible correction and verify function without standing up a heavy FRACAS board.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Data quality, ownership, change authority, configuration traceability, representative retest and recurrence horizon.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Converts failure experience into verified design/support improvement rather than incident accumulation.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Design authority, reliability manager, maintainer, fleet/service owner and acceptance authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Ticket closure gaming; duplicate fragmentation; symptom fixes; selective test continuation; unimplemented fleet fixes; no recurrence denominator.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: FRACAS can become labour-intensive bureaucracy and reliability-growth models can reward test selection or delayed fixes.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Failure logs evolved toward configuration-bound causal corrective action, delayed-fix treatment, recurrence families and decision-focused closure.

properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable configuration, representative units/profile, independent or modelled dependence, calibrated instruments and failure adjudication.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Acceptance authority, mission owner, designer, regulator/procurer and service owner.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Low power; sample substitution; censoring bias; correlated units; success-run overclaim; arbitrary confidence; changing configuration.

properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Pass/fail qualification evolved toward estimand-specific, confidence- and uncertainty-explicit demonstrations plus field updating.

properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should demonstration confidence be combined with mechanism knowledge and post-deployment evidence without double-counting?

properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Accelerated life testing, Arrhenius/stress-life models, environmental testing, ESS and highly accelerated discovery methods.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Raise temperature, voltage, vibration or use rate to observe failures faster and extrapolate to field life.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Long field lives make direct tests slow, but excessive/wrong stress can activate different mechanisms or invalidate extrapolation.

properties.MECHANISM: Select stress from physics/mechanism; verify failure-mode equivalence; use multiple levels; validate model; separate screening/discovery from quantitative life estimation.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Known stress-accelerable degradation, long life, design comparison or mechanism discovery.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use direct field-like stress, engineering margin or targeted destructive test when quantitative acceleration adds no decision value.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Mechanism knowledge, stress control, representative specimens, sufficient failures/censoring data, covariates and uncertainty propagation.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Obtains earlier evidence without confusing non-field damage with field reliability.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reliability engineer, design/materials owner, qualification authority and maintenance planner.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Wrong activation energy; combined stresses; threshold/nonlinear effects; sample ageing; over-extrapolation; screening damage.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Acceleration models are often selected for convenience and validated over too narrow a stress range.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Generic high-stress tests narrowed toward physics-of-failure, mechanism-confirmed acceleration and discovery-versus-demonstration separation.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A mechanism-linked acceleration case with failure-mode confirmation, model diagnostics, uncertainty and explicit non-transfer regions.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A chamber test, HALT or ESS label is not the property; decision-relevant evidence about the field mechanism is.

properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: When mechanism and acceleration relation are validated, ALT has strong formal and industrial value.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can mechanism equivalence be demonstrated for interacting modern electronics/material/software-controlled loads?

properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Jelinski–Moranda and Goel–Okumoto growth models; Musa operational profiles; field software failure studies.

properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Software does not wear out like hardware; failures require fault activation by inputs/state, and fixes/releases alter the population and profile.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Probability/intensity of software-caused functional failure for the current version under the declared input/state/workload profile.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Fault-content model treated as literal; perfect fix assumed; test inputs unrepresentative; interactions/dependencies omitted; version changes invalidate growth curve.
properties.MECHANISM: Use operational-profile testing, failure-severity/state classification, version binding, model comparison, fix-effect evidence and post-release monitoring.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Software-dominated function with enough repeated operations/failures for an estimable question and a stable release/profile window.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use targeted functional, property, stress and regression tests when a numerical software failure-rate model will not change the decision.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Current version/configuration, input/state distribution, failure oracle, exposure, fix history and dependency environment.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Avoids importing wear-out assumptions while preserving probabilistic evidence for activated faults.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Software/reliability engineer, release authority, service owner and mission owner.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Perfect debugging; independent faults; stable profile; common-mode dependency; rare catastrophic paths; test oracle failure.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Many growth models fit historical curves similarly yet extrapolate poorly; model selection after seeing data invites overfit.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Fault-count curves evolved toward operational-profile, severity, state, architecture/dependency and change-aware evidence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A version- and profile-bound software functional-failure claim triangulated by targeted tests, field exposure and uncertainty—not a generic “software MTBF.”
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A software reliability growth chart is optional; representative evidence about the current executable behaviour is.

properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: For stable narrow programs with controlled profiles, SRGMs can support planning; transfer beyond those assumptions is weak.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should software reliability evidence account for adaptive configuration and continuously deployed code without meaningless averaging?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: User-journey and consumer-consequence service reliability
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: High-availability service engineering, SRE SLIs/SLOs and end-to-end operational monitoring.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Measure request success/latency and service uptime.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Component or aggregate request metrics can remain green while critical multi-step journeys, user classes, freshness, durability or partial service fail.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Named consumer journey achieves correct, timely, sufficiently fresh/durable outcome over the relevant window and dependencies.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Request-weighted average hides a small user cohort, tail latency, dependency path, stale data, partial outage or repeated short disruptions.
properties.MECHANISM: Define journey-level outcomes; stratify consumers and consequence; include tails/freshness/durability; measure dependency and degraded-state success.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Externally consumed software/service whose important outcomes span components, dependencies or multiple steps.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For simple single-step services, one end-to-end functional probe plus incident review may be sufficient.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Consumer definitions, telemetry across journey, privacy-preserving correlation, state correctness, dependency observability and denominator governance.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Aligns service reliability decisions with actual utility rather than local uptime.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: End users, mission/business owner, service owner and on-call operator.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Synthetic probe differs from real user; missing client-side failures; aggregation; bot/request volume dominates; rare critical journey underweighted.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: User happiness is multidimensional and difficult to reduce to a ratio; measurement itself can be incomplete or inequitable.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Machine/process uptime evolved toward request outcomes, tails, user journeys, cohorts, freshness and consequence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A small set of end-to-end, cohort-aware, consequence-linked measures with diagnostic drill-down and explicit blind spots.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A dashboard or “golden signals” panel is not the property; current evidence that consumers receive required outcomes is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Meta’s DNS servers were locally operational but users could not reach services; GitLab separated code-repository integrity from database data loss (SRC-059, SRC-060).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No single user-journey metric covers all consequences; qualitative incident evidence and targeted tests remain necessary.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should reliability protect low-volume high-consequence consumers without allowing arbitrary metric proliferation?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: SLI/SLO and error-budget governance as a scoped decision aid
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Google SRE practice and subsequent industrial adoption/critique.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Set an SLO below 100%, measure bad events, and spend the error budget to balance reliability and change velocity.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Teams need an operational threshold linking observed service outcomes to release, stabilisation and alert decisions.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: A user/mission-relevant outcome remains within an agreed loss budget over a declared denominator/window, with action when exhausted.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Easy metric chosen; time/event denominator mismatch; cohort/tail hidden; maintenance excluded; budget treated as permission; chronic exhaustion creates nonsense.
properties.MECHANISM: Select user-relevant SLI; document denominator/window/exclusions; use burn-rate/tail/cohort views; preagree actions; review validity and gaming.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Repeatable online service with measurable consumer outcomes and cross-functional authority to act on budget state.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use direct incident/change judgement for small or low-volume services where a stable ratio is misleading.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Reliable telemetry, user-journey mapping, stakeholder agreement, release authority, dependency awareness and review cadence.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Creates a common, current decision signal and makes reliability/change trade-offs explicit.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Service owner, product/change authority, on-call and users represented by the SLI.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Nine-count branding; denominator manipulation; omitted cohorts; short/long outage equivalence; chronic debt; threshold chosen backwards from current performance.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Boolean ratios fit request/response better than many other services; correct error-budget response and alert thresholds remain contested.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Uptime targets evolved toward user-focused SLIs, multiwindow burn rates, policy actions and explicit critique of denominator/threshold assumptions.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A revisable, consumer-grounded governance instrument used alongside incident, dependency and tail evidence—not a universal reliability score.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The SLO dashboard and error-budget ritual are optional; the property is a valid current decision boundary and agreed response.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: SRE practice supplies detailed operational mechanisms, while practitioner critiques identify denominator, threshold and chronic-budget failure modes (SRC-063–SRC-067).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No robust multi-organisation evidence establishes one SLO formula or error-budget policy as universally optimal.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What empirical decision rules best respond to budget exhaustion across different service archetypes and consequence distributions?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: End-to-end health checks and symptom-versus-cause separation
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Built-in test/liveness checks, model-based diagnosis and SRE symptom-oriented monitoring.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Poll component liveness and page on unhealthy status.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A component heartbeat can be green while the actual path is unusable; conversely a symptom can identify impact without establishing cause.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Detect end-to-end functional loss quickly while preserving a separate evidence path for causal diagnosis.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Shallow probe; cached/static response; monitor bypasses dependency/state/authentication; probe shares failure; symptom automatically labelled root cause.
properties.MECHANISM: Use layered probes: end-to-end outcome for impact, component/dependency signals for diagnosis; test probe coverage/failure; validate after recovery.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Remote automated service, failover, load balancer health, readiness/liveness, synthetic transactions or auto-remediation.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A direct user-visible transaction is often cheaper and stronger than many internal health bits.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Representative journey, safe test account/data, independent monitoring path, timing and known blind spots.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces false-green availability and shortens diagnosis without confusing symptom with mechanism.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: On-call operator, automated traffic manager, incident commander and users.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Probe not representative; synthetic succeeds while cohort fails; health endpoint isolated from data plane; monitor unavailable; causal overreach.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Deep probes can be costly, create load or mutate state; they cannot cover all semantic outcomes.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Single component heartbeat evolved toward layered end-to-end functional monitoring, cohort telemetry and dependency diagnosis.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A documented coverage stack: user/mission outcome detection, diagnostic signals, independent probe health and post-recovery validation.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A green checkmark is not the property; observed required function plus understood coverage is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Meta’s DNS servers were operational but unreachable, a direct example of a locally green component and failed service path (SRC-059).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No finite set of health checks proves absence of latent or unknown semantic failure.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can probe representativeness be continuously estimated as user journeys and dependencies change?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Explicit dependency, correlation and hidden single-point mapping
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: RBD/FTA serial structures, supply/logistics analysis and modern cloud/service dependency mapping.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Represent series/parallel component dependencies in an RBD.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Architecture diagrams omit shared DNS, identity, control planes, libraries, regions, suppliers, spares, people or change channels that dominate failure.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Every dependency necessary for the critical function or its recovery is identified with consequence, alternatives and correlation.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Unknown transitive dependency; fallback uses same provider/control; SLA substitutes for observed performance; human/on-call or logistics bottleneck omitted.
properties.MECHANISM: Discover runtime and organisational dependencies; classify criticality/failure domains; test fallback; record correlated change/maintenance; monitor supplier performance.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: End-to-end service, outsourced/supplier component, multi-region design, recovery plan, shared platform or long logistics chain.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For simple systems, trace one critical user/mission path and its recovery path rather than build a universal service map.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Telemetry/tracing, contracts plus observed data, architecture and support knowledge, ownership and change notifications.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Exposes serial reliability and common-cause risks that component metrics and nominal redundancy hide.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Architect, service/fleet owner, supplier manager, operator, continuity planner and mission owner.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Dynamic discovery gaps; shadow dependency; circular fallback; shared credentials; control-plane dependence; concentrated maintainer/supplier.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Maps go stale quickly and can become inventory ceremony; causal dependence is richer than static edges.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Static blocks evolved toward dynamic, transitive, control/state/human/supply dependency and correlated-change models.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A decision-focused dependency model refreshed by telemetry and incidents, including recovery dependencies and credible fallback evidence.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A service map is not the property; knowing which shared dependency can defeat required function and what is done about it is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: AWS, Meta and CrowdStrike incidents demonstrate storage, backbone/DNS and shared supplier/update dependencies with broad correlated impact (SRC-058, SRC-059, SRC-061, SRC-062).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Dependency elimination is impossible; some shared platforms improve reliability through expertise and scale, so the property is visibility and evidence, not universal decentralisation.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can hidden control-plane and organisational dependencies be discovered before a failure removes the discovery tools?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Inject component or service failures to see whether redundancy/recovery works.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Analytical claims about detection, containment, degradation and recovery can remain untested in the integrated current system.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Discriminate a live reliability uncertainty for a specified fault, profile, boundary and decision without causing disproportionate harm.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Random breakage; nonrepresentative fault; weak oracle; no decision consumer; production risk exceeds value; repeated ritual after claim already established.
properties.MECHANISM: State hypothesis/steady-state metric; choose representative fault and blast radius; predefine abort; observe full recovery/postconditions; record decision/update.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Material integrated uncertainty not cheaply resolved by static analysis, simulation, staging or direct functional test.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use unit/integration test, simulation, replay or nonproduction exercise when it resolves the same uncertainty more safely/cheaply.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Containment, observability, recovery readiness, representative load/state, authorisation, abort/fallback and post-experiment analysis.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Finds integration/coverage gaps and supplies current empirical evidence for specific resilience claims.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Service/mission owner, operator, reliability engineer and change authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Toy fault; survivorship; experiment itself causes outage; only steady-state metric checked; no state validation; outcomes not acted upon.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Industrial evidence is advocacy-heavy; systematic review still finds evaluation and adoption gaps; production experimentation creates ethical/operational risk.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Fault injection evolved from component coverage testing toward hypothesis-driven system experiments with blast-radius and decision controls.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A sparse portfolio of claim-bound experiments chosen by expected information value and closed through recovery validation and engineering action.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: “Chaos day,” monkey tooling or periodic failure ritual is not the property; decision-relevant falsification is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Meta’s long-running storm drills aided staged restoration but had never simulated global-backbone loss, illustrating both value and coverage limits (SRC-059).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: A successful experiment proves only the tested conditions; it never establishes general resilience.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What empirical designs best estimate transfer from controlled experiments to rare correlated production failures?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Overload-aware recovery: capacity margin, load shedding and bounded retries
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Queueing/capacity practice, high-availability service recovery and overload-control patterns.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Keep spare capacity, shed low-priority load and retry failed requests.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Failure removes capacity while backlog/retries increase demand, so failover/restart can trigger a second collapse.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Protect priority function and recover without unstable positive feedback or exhaustion of the remaining fault-tolerant capacity.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Retry storm; thundering herd; failover target underprovisioned; cache cold start; load shedding removes critical work; no admission control.
properties.MECHANISM: Reserve margin; classify load; cap/constrain retries; exponential backoff/jitter; circuit break; shed by priority; ramp recovery; test cold/failed capacity.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Elastic/queued services, failover, regional loss, dependency slowdown, mass restart or bursty demand.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Reject clearly and early rather than queue/retry when capacity is exhausted and work is safely repeatable later.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Demand/capacity observability, priority semantics, idempotency, queue limits, fallback and consumer communication.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents recovery mechanisms from amplifying the initiating fault and preserves critical service.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Operator, service owner, priority users and incident commander.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Incorrect priorities; hidden downstream bottleneck; stale capacity estimate; retries across many clients synchronise; shed work not recoverable.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Spare capacity costs money/energy; load shedding can externalise harm and obscure underinvestment.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Static N+1 margin evolved toward dynamic admission, priority shedding, retry budgets and staged reconstitution.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A measured stability envelope and failure-mode-specific overload policy, including consumer consequences and recovery postconditions.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A circuit-breaker library or autoscaler is not the property; stable protected operation under the target loss is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: AWS reported backlogs after S3 recovery; Meta explicitly avoided turning all services on at once because caches, power and systems could crash (SRC-058, SRC-059).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: For non-queued fixed-demand systems this property may not trigger; extra mechanisms can add complexity.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should retry/load-shed policies coordinate across independently owned clients and dependencies?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Observability and evidence preservation during failure and recovery
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Built-in test/maintenance records, incident logging, flight/industrial recorders and service observability.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Log faults and maintenance actions for troubleshooting and FRACAS.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The initiating failure or automatic remediation destroys/overwrites telemetry, tools, clocks or state needed to diagnose, validate recovery and prevent recurrence.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Retain sufficient trustworthy evidence to determine impact, state, likely causes, actions and post-recovery correctness within time/privacy constraints.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Logs share failed control plane; clocks diverge; restart erases state; auto-remediation loops; high volume drops key evidence; recovery contaminates artefacts.
properties.MECHANISM: Independent/remote telemetry paths; durable event/action records; time/identity correlation; bounded snapshots; evidence-preserving recovery mode; privacy/access governance.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Complex automated systems, correlated outages, remote repair, stateful recovery or rare high-consequence events.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For simple deterministic faults, record the minimal causal/action evidence rather than instrument everything.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Independent power/network/storage where warranted, data quality, clocks, access, retention, privacy and incident procedures.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Shortens diagnosis, supports state reconciliation and allows corrective-action effectiveness to be tested.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Operator, maintainer, incident investigator, design owner and return-to-service authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Telemetry blind spot; observer overload; misleading stale metrics; data loss; sensitive evidence withheld; logs treated as ground truth.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Observability can be costly, intrusive and security/privacy-sensitive; more data does not guarantee diagnosis.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Fault codes evolved toward distributed traces, event/state provenance, recovery journals and independent evidence channels.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Decision-focused observability resilient to the target failure, with known coverage, integrity, retention and evidence-preserving automation.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A logging stack is not the property; reliable evidence for live decisions and recurrence learning is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Meta lost normal and out-of-band access and many internal tools during the outage, directly showing diagnostic dependencies can fail with the system (SRC-059).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: In some failures independent physical inspection or direct test is more informative than extensive telemetry.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can evidence integrity and privacy be preserved when autonomous recovery acts faster than human review?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Retirement of stale controls, metrics, support and reliability claims
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Configuration/obsolescence management, field-data refresh and metric-governance practice.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Review reliability predictions, maintenance plans and support resources periodically.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Controls, thresholds, spares, procedures, models and dashboards persist after configuration/profile/consumer change and create false assurance or burden.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Only current, decision-relevant reliability controls and support capabilities govern the current system.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Obsolete spare/tool; unsupported dependency; stale profile; dead alert; inherited “nine”; old backup format; handbook rate for changed technology.
properties.MECHANISM: Attach owner, scope, evidence, configuration, review/expiry and retirement trigger; monitor obsolescence; remove or replace controls that no longer discriminate risk.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Technology/configuration/profile/consumer change, repeated false alarms, unused metric, support deprecation or expired evidence.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Delete a stale metric/control when no consumer or decision can be named; retain a simple direct check if still useful.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Inventory and ownership, configuration/dependency change signals, evidence lineage and authority to retire contractual/process residue.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces false confidence, alert/maintenance burden and unsupported recovery dependence.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: System/service owner, maintainer, operator, procurement and assurance authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Zombie dashboard; contract inertia; metric tied to bonus; unsupported library/part; retirement removes latent protection; no replacement evidence.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Frequent change can erode comparability and institutional memory; retirement needs archival trace and consequence check.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Periodic document review broadened to live evidence freshness, control efficacy, dependency support and obsolescence risk.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Every material reliability control has a current consumer, evidence basis, configuration scope, expiry and safe retirement/replacement path.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Keeping a metric because it exists is ceremony; deliberate retention or retirement is the property.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: The MIL-HDBK-217 critique shows how outdated data/models can persist institutionally after technology changes (SRC-047).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Long-lived controls may encode rare lessons; deletion without historical analysis can reintroduce old failure modes.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What evidence should trigger retirement when the protected failure is rare and absence may reflect the control’s success?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Design diversity as conditional common-mode mitigation
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: N-version programming, diverse hardware/software channels and common-cause mitigation.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Develop multiple independent versions and vote to tolerate design faults.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Identical redundancy shares systematic faults; diversity may reduce common modes but independence is not guaranteed.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: At least one/adjudicated implementation remains correct for the target input/fault class without shared specification/model/tool failure.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Common specification ambiguity; difficult inputs induce similar errors; shared algorithm/library/data/model; voter/acceptance test wrong; diversity overwhelms maintenance.
properties.MECHANISM: Diversify selected causal dimensions; analyse shared assumptions; use independent evidence/teams/tools where valuable; test coincident errors; preserve diagnosability and update compatibility.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Systematic design/software/model failure dominates and consequence justifies multiple implementations.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Prefer one simple implementation plus strong specification/tests when diversity cost and shared assumptions erase benefit.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Clear specification/oracle, adjudication, independent causal pathways, configuration control, joint-failure evidence and maintenance capacity.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Can reduce some common design faults that identical replicas cannot tolerate.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Architect, mission authority, software/reliability owner and maintainer.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Correlated mistakes; shared training data/model; specification error; voter failure; patch divergence; extra interfaces and operational burden.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Knight–Leveson and Eckhardt–Lee directly undermine naïve independence; “different code” is not “independent failure.”
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: N-version slogans narrowed toward targeted causal diversity with explicit common assumptions, joint testing and lifecycle cost.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A quantified/argued diversity case naming which common modes are reduced, which remain shared, adjudication coverage and maintenance/recovery consequences.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Separate teams or languages are not the property; reduced joint failure for identified causes is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Homogeneous ecosystem updates can propagate broadly (SRC-061, SRC-062), but empirical multiversion studies show diversity cannot be assumed independent (SRC-014).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Properly chosen physical, technological or supplier diversity can materially reduce specific common causes.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can diversity benefit be measured for modern AI/model/data stacks where many hidden assumptions are shared?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: MTBF as a universal scalar for reliability
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Constant-rate electronic reliability prediction and repairable-system HPP practice.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Represent reliability by mean time between failures, often as the reciprocal of a constant failure rate.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A convenient scalar is used to compare items and plan tests/spares.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: No standalone required function is protected; MTBF is an estimand only under a defined recurrent-event process and failure definition.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Mean hides mission time, hazard shape, tail, repair, severity, dependence and functional consequence; constant-rate premise is unstated.
properties.MECHANISM: Rejected as a universal property; retain MTBF only as a model-qualified descriptive measure with confidence and exposure.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Only when recurrent failures are reasonably represented by HPP/constant intensity or as an explicitly limited empirical mean.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Report exposure, failure count/intensity, uncertainty and mission reliability directly.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable failure definition, repairable-system process, representative exposure, constant-intensity validation if exponential inference is made.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Limited: compact planning/comparison measure inside its valid model.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Test planner, maintenance/logistics analyst or model user—not a generic mission consumer.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: “MTBF 100,000 h” read as life; reciprocal used without constant hazard; mixed failures; no confidence; predicted part rates summed as field truth.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: NIST makes the constant-rate assumption explicit; the National Academies critique documents handbook misuse and inaccurate predictions.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Universal slogan narrowed to one estimand among mission reliability, failure intensity, life distribution and availability measures.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use only with declared model, failure population, exposure, confidence and decision; never substitute it for mission or field reliability.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The target/slogan is ceremony when detached from model and mission.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Field and incident data show severity and correlated outages can dominate a mean interval.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: MTBF remains mathematically coherent and operationally useful in some stationary repairable-system contexts.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What communication formats most reliably prevent non-experts from reading MTBF as expected lifetime?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: “Five nines” as a universal service-reliability claim
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Telecommunications/high-availability uptime targets and later service marketing/SRE shorthand.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Express annual allowed downtime by counting nines of availability.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Communicate a compact availability objective.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: No universal function; validity requires a specific SLI, denominator, scope, consumer, window and exclusions.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Nines hide whether failures are one long outage or many interruptions, which users/regions/journeys count, degraded service, data correctness and correlated dependency loss.
properties.MECHANISM: Reject the slogan as evidence; translate to consumer journeys, outage distribution, tails, consequence and recovery objectives.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Only as shorthand after full metric semantics are already defined and understood.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: State maximum tolerable outage patterns or direct user/mission outcomes instead.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Valid SLI/denominator, complete telemetry, user weighting, interval, planned-maintenance treatment and outage-shape analysis.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Limited communication convenience.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Service stakeholders who already understand the full definition.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Marketing without scope; request-weighting; excluded windows; short-outage accumulation; partial outage hidden; regional correlation.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: USENIX criticism directly questions whether counting nines reflects user experience and notes inability to distinguish outage shapes.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Nines were supplemented by user-focused SLIs, SLOs, burn rates, cohorts, tails and incident consequence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Never claim reliability from the number of nines alone; publish the underlying outcome distribution and scope.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The nines badge is the ceremony.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Large correlated outages can dominate consequence even when annual percentage remains numerically high (SRC-058, SRC-059, SRC-062).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: A well-defined availability percentage can be useful for capacity/contract decisions; the universal branding is rejected.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which outage-shape and cohort summaries best accompany a percentage without overwhelming public communication?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Universal bathtub-curve assumption
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Early lifetime/hazard modelling and an influential three-phase graphical idealisation.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Assume every product has infant mortality, a constant-hazard useful life, then wear-out.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Provide an intuitive lifecycle story for screening, random failures and replacement.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: No standalone mission property; it is a candidate hazard-shape model.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Observed modes/populations do not exhibit all phases; mixtures create aggregate shape; item changes/maintenance violate stationary phases; policy follows the sketch rather than data/mechanism.
properties.MECHANISM: Reject universality; fit/compare distributions and mechanisms, stratify populations, use repairable-event models where appropriate.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Use only when mechanism and data support the relevant segment for the decision.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Plot empirical hazard/ROCOF with uncertainty or use a conservative nonparametric bound.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Life data with censoring, homogeneous enough population, mechanism knowledge, exposure and model diagnostics.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Limited conceptual aid when its phases actually match the system.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reliability analyst and maintenance planner.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Forced constant hazard; age replacement without wear-out; burn-in for non-infant modes; population mixture; repairable system treated as lifetime sample.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Peer-reviewed critique and RCM field evidence directly reject universal use.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: A universal lifecycle picture narrowed to one possible hazard pattern among many, with mechanism-specific maintenance.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Treat the bathtub as a hypothesis/teaching model, never an assumed empirical law.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The curve on a slide is ceremony when it predetermines policy.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Nowlan and Heap’s aircraft component study documented six patterns and set mechanism-specific maintenance conditions (SRC-008).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Some physical products genuinely show early defects, a useful-life plateau and wear-out; local use remains valid.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How often are aggregate bathtub shapes artefacts of heterogeneous cohorts rather than individual mechanisms?

properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Demonstrate transfer capability.

properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Only nominal fault; shared control survives; secondary warm; no state divergence; no user journey; no return/failback; stale evidence after change.
properties.MECHANISM: Reject generalisation; maintain scenario/claim coverage, current configuration, correlated faults, load/state, recovery/failback and postcondition evidence.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A failover test is one evidence item when it discriminates a live claim.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Directly verify the changed component/path after small changes; reserve full exercises for material uncertainties.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: ERM-P008/009, current state, representative fault/load, independent observability, abort and recovery validation.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: A well-designed test supports the tested scenario only.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Continuity/service owner and acceptance authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Happy-path failover; no latent standby; control plane excluded; no load; state loss hidden; test environment unlike field.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Meta’s drills helped, but the actual global-backbone failure was outside exercised coverage.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Annual DR ritual evolved toward claim-based, configuration-aware scenario portfolios and continuous cheaper checks.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: State exactly which fault/state/load/postconditions the exercise established and which remain untested.
