properties.PROPERTY_NAME: No incidents or lower incident count as proof of reliability improvement
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Failure-count/growth tracking and modern incident metrics.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use fewer failures/incidents over time as evidence of improvement.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Provide a simple trend signal.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: No standalone function is established without exposure, severity, detection/reporting and configuration/profile context.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Lower demand; hidden/uncaught incidents; severity reclassification; fewer but larger correlated outages; reporting suppression; changed denominator.
properties.MECHANISM: Reject raw count; normalise by exposure/profile, stratify consequence and recurrence family, track latent/near-miss evidence and detection changes.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Use incident rates only with stable definitions/exposure and as one part of ERM-P024/025/028 evidence.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For low counts, inspect each failure mechanism and consequence rather than model a trend.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Event definition, exposure, detection/reporting consistency, severity, configuration and recurrence families.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Limited signal when denominators and ascertainment are stable.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reliability/service owner and decision authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Goodhart effects; ticket splitting/merging; reporting fear; observation changes; tail hidden by count.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Incident absence is compatible with latent failure, low exposure or weak detection.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Raw counts evolved toward exposure-normalised rates, user impact, recurrence and causal corrective-action evidence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Treat count as descriptive; claim improvement only with stable exposure, detection and mechanism/impact evidence.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Incident-count OKR is the ceremony.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Large low-frequency outages show count alone can underrepresent consequence (SRC-058, SRC-059, SRC-062).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: With stable exposure/reporting and enough events, rates are valid evidence; raw count remains insufficient.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can near misses and latent faults be integrated without incentivising over-reporting games?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: More redundancy always improves reliability
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Parallel RBD arithmetic and fault-tolerance intuition.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Add copies/paths so independent joint failure becomes less likely.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Reduce random component failure probability.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Improved mission outcome after specified faults, not increased component count.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Common cause, voter/switch fault, dormant spare, state split, capacity/overload, maintenance complexity, update concentration or new interfaces dominate.
properties.MECHANISM: Reject monotonic slogan; apply ERM-P008/009/040 and compare total system reliability/maintainability under dependence and coverage.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Add redundancy only when failure modes, domains, coverage, state and lifecycle burden support positive net value.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Simplify/eliminate the failure cause, add a manual spare, improve repair, or accept risk when redundancy burden exceeds benefit.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Common-cause model, transfer coverage, capacity/state, maintenance/support and evidence.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Can be large under valid independence; can be negative otherwise.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Architect and mission/risk authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Shared power/control/specification; hidden standby; complexity; simultaneous maintenance; false failover; correlated release.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Formal and empirical literature directly show dependence can destroy the multiplicative benefit.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Copy-count reasoning evolved toward failure-domain, coverage, diversity, state and supportability cases.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: No redundancy claim without a total-system conditional argument and cheaper-path comparison.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The N+1/TMR diagram is the ceremony when assumptions are unstated.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Nominal standby/backup failures and shared-update incidents show added copies do not imply independent service (SRC-060–SRC-062).
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Independent, observable, maintainable redundancy remains one of the strongest reliability mechanisms.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should engineering teams quantify negative reliability from operational complexity before deployment?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: AI/ML/agentic diagnosis or auto-remediation as a general reliability property
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: ML anomaly detection/PHM, AIOps, autonomous repair and rapidly emerging agentic systems.
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use learned models/agents to detect anomalies, diagnose causes, predict failure and autonomously remediate.
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Complex systems produce more telemetry and faster events than humans can always interpret or act on.
properties.REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION: Improve detection/restoration outcomes for a defined function without introducing unacceptable nondeterminism, drift, authority or cascading risk.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Distribution drift; uncalibrated confidence; opaque cause; tool/action hallucination; shared model/data dependency; unsafe authority; repeated remediation loop; evidence destruction.
properties.MECHANISM: Bound use case/action authority; monitor postdeployment drift; expose uncertainty/abstention; require independent functional postconditions; sandbox/canary/reversible actions; human escalation and non-AI fallback.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Narrow, observable tasks with representative evaluation, reversible bounded action and independent verification where automation value exceeds risk.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Rules, deterministic functional checks, manual diagnosis or conventional automation when they resolve the same task more transparently.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Current data/profile, trusted telemetry, calibration, drift detection, action sandbox, configuration/state authority, recovery fallback and governance.
properties.OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS: A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.
properties.FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS: A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.
properties.REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS: No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.
properties.DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS: Enumerated fault/failure population, observable signals, calibrated thresholds, isolation resolution, false-alarm and missed-detection costs.
properties.RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS: A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.
properties.MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS: The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Potential speed/scale improvement in bounded diagnostics or remediation; no general field-reliability claim is established.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Operator, maintainer, service/mission owner and automation authority.
properties.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Nondeterminism; brittleness; hidden shared assumptions; out-of-distribution faults; false confidence; prompt/tool injection as boundary; action compounding; accountability gap.
properties.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: NIST 2024/2026 sources describe assurance, coverage, monitoring and validation methods as active challenges; evidence is nascent and use-case specific.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: ML prediction expanded toward deployed monitoring and agents, while assurance shifted toward lifecycle monitoring, uncertainty, authority limits and independent validation.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Only a domain-specific assistive/automated mechanism with bounded function, calibrated uncertainty, drift monitoring, reversible authority, independent postconditions and fallback.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: “AI-powered reliability” branding or an agent demo is not the property; demonstrated bounded net dependability is.
properties.EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE: Current authoritative sources establish monitoring/assurance challenges; no broad multi-domain evidence establishes autonomous agents as a general reliability improvement.
properties.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Narrow anomaly detection, prognostics and automated repair can outperform manual/rule baselines in specific validated settings.
properties.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can agent action reliability, tool/state authority, joint human–automation recovery and rare cascading errors be demonstrated prospectively?

FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.END_EFFECT: Distribution drift; uncalibrated confidence; opaque cause; tool/action hallucination; shared model/data dependency; unsafe authority; repeated remediation loop; evidence destruction.

FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE.LATENT_CONDITION: Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.
